neighbours.label: ' is' after a universal or scriptural subject: 'Every good gift is', 'Whatever is in heaven is'
fire: Every good thing in life is from above.
Whatever you see in the sky is a gift.
Every perfect flower in the field is from God.
All that exists in the world is his.
Whatever is born of the spirit is spirit.
Every word of the law is true.
Everything under the sun is passing away.
Every breath we take is a blessing.
quiet: My old thing in the car is from Ohio.
That bird you see in the sky is a gull.
The small flower in the field is blue.
The shop that opened in town is his.
The baby born in the spring is well.
The word on the sign is red.
The table under the tree is falling apart.
The bus we take is a blue one.

notes: Card: ' is' 18, ' are' 11 of the top 32. Probes: 'Every good and perfect gift is' 1.06, 's[:i+1] is' 0.62, 'code is' 0.10; 'My brother is' 0.05. The code example is not covered by this label.
